title: Measurability of composed Gaussian stability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a measurable space, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be measurable functions taking values in $[0,1]$. Then $x\mapsto G_\rho(f(x),g(x))$ is measurable, where $G_\rho(\alpha,\beta)$ is the probability that a pair $(Z,\rho Z+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,W)$ has respective standard Gaussian distribution-function values at most $\alpha$ and $\beta$, with $Z,W$ independent standard Gaussian random variables.
